reduced_positive_rational.sign_location: none; a unit scale is strictly positive

decision_order: resolve both unit symbols in the already selected active catalogs
require exactly one catalog row per resolved UnitId and exactly one canonical unit per DimensionId
reject an approximate, provider-backed, offset, calendar, zero, negative or non-rational edge
normalize every exact scale to ReducedPositiveRational
require an explicit target display unit or one exact context-anchor display decision
select exactly one ScaleByReducedRatio<Rep> plan under the closed representation matrix

catalog_closure.cycle_law: the reduced product of every finite cycle is exactly 1/1
catalog_closure.path_law: all finite paths between the same two UnitIds reduce to the same ratio

input: explicit witness carrier or context-anchor identity
algorithm: sort active catalogs by canonical UnitCatalogId
resolve the unit symbol to exactly one UnitId without provider fallback
require that UnitId's DimensionId and Rep constraints to match the expected Measure type
if an explicit unit witness carrier is present, seal it; otherwise require exactly one in-scope context anchor
seal KnownUnitWitnessId plus UnitCatalogId, UnitId, DimensionId and RepTypeId in typed HIR
known_unit_witness_selection.termination_measure: finite active catalogs plus finite unit rows plus at most one explicit/context anchor
known_unit_witness_selection.function_boundary_law: Measure<Rep, Dim> alone preserves no display UnitId; an explicit unit witness parameter/carrier or a separately sealed context anchor is required after such a boundary
known_unit_witness_selection.loss_rule: crossing a boundary whose type/API digest carries no KnownUnitWitnessId discards display identity deterministically and never reconstructs it from runtime values

scalar_operation_plan.selection_time: after unit ratio and Rep are fixed, before UnitConversionPlanV1 is sealed

matrix.Rational: admit every reduced exact ratio; checked AllocationError/allocate responsibility follows the selected Rational witness
matrix.integral: admit only when the fully reduced numeric result denominator is exactly 1 and the checked result is representable; overflow is ArithmeticDefect before commit
matrix.Float32_or_Float64: admit only with one explicit deterministic RoundingWitnessId bound in the API/checker environment
matrix.other_Rep: admit only with one exact selected ScaleByReducedRatio<Rep> conformance whose responsibility and rounding law are sealed

exact_ratio_conversion.dynamic_boundary: The sealed ScaleByReducedRatio<Rep> plan performs the numeric multiply/divide under its exact representation and rounding law. The backend may not replace the ratio, promote Rep, truncate, choose rounding or display identity, reconstruct a witness, or invoke a provider.

affine_units.reason: The current UnitCatalog grammar has no point/delta or offset declaration and therefore cannot bind a sound Point/Delta law without adding a new source surface.
reopen_conditions: a separate Design_ decision selects exact source declarations for point and delta units
offset and scale normalization are closed without implicit provider lookup
positive, boundary and rejection fixtures bind the selected surface

source_contract.shape: finite statically known nonnegative StaticInt dimensions
source_contract.generator_expression_evaluation_count: exactly one when cardinality > 0; zero when cardinality == 0
source_contract.element_request_order: row-major logical coordinate order, each coordinate exactly once
source_contract.result_contract: the already selected ordinary callable accepts the exact logical coordinate tuple and returns the array element type
source_contract.effect_error_contract: the callable's sealed EffectRow and ErrorSet are preserved; no provider effects or errors are inferred
source_contract.failure_atomicity: shape validation and result storage reservation precede the first call; a failed call cleans the constructed prefix in reverse order and publishes no partial array

positive: Measure<Rational, Length> containing 250[cm] converts exactly to 5/2[m]
Measure<Int, Length> containing 2500[m] converts to 2[km] only when the fully reduced result is integral and representable
a nonempty shaped generator invokes the exact selected callable once per logical coordinate
boundary: a zero-cardinality shaped generator evaluates neither generator expression nor provider
multiple exact catalog paths are admitted only when their reduced ratios are identical
reject: Measure<Int, Length> containing 250[cm] cannot convert to metres because the reduced result denominator is not 1
Float or other Rep conversion without one exact rounding or ScaleByReducedRatio witness
implicit context anchor after a function boundary that preserved only Measure<Rep, Dim>
affine point unit in the current source profile
provider availability used to change shaped-generator admission
